name: Weather, Hourly
description: Hourly temperature line with a shaded area + condition-icon strip across the top. Defaults to the next 12 hours; configurable to 24 or 48. Data from Open-Meteo (no API key).

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Location
cell_options.help: Search a city to set the location. The latitude / longitude that drive the weather data come from the picked result; the Label below auto-fills with the city name.

cell_options.name: label
cell_options.label: Label
cell_options.help: Auto-filled from the location pick; edit to customise (e.g. 'Home' instead of 'Berlin').
